scopeNotes: BLS percentages are business weights, not worker outcomes.94.8% single-period and5.2% multiple; four-frequency distribution is single only.
Government and private/public education require separate proxy options. Farm/unknown-owner extrapolation is outside the source cohort and remains explicitly estimated.
BLS size bins use prior twelve-month maximum employment. No current-headcount bins are used by this candidate.
No original source supplies a fictional employer phase, lag, holiday rule, group membership or legal-frequency compliance.
SantaBarbara actual holiday overrides are not represented by the no-adjustment pure resolver. They are not silently claimed as copied.
FailedCalifornia HTML fetch and failedDOL403 are not calendar or legal evidence.
